description: Read a health snapshot for support/debugging: SDK + LWK versions, data dir, backup state, sync health (last scan/success and the last update-persist failure), per-rail pending counters, and the guardrail budget. Read-only and local (no network, no signing) and carries NO key material — never the seed, mnemonic or descriptor. Moves no money.
name: wallet_diagnostics

api_key_configured.description: Whether a DePix API key is set (deposit/withdraw need one).

backup_confirmed.description: Whether the seed backup was confirmed (§2.9).

data_dir.description: The wallet data directory (local path — no key material lives in this snapshot).

allowlist_enabled.description: Whether the owner turned the destination allowlist on (§4.3).

daily_limit_cents.description: Owner-set rolling-24h cap in BRL cents (§4.2).

per_tx_limit_cents.description: Owner-set per-transaction cap in BRL cents (§4.2).

used_cents.description: BRL cents committed in the rolling 24h window.

guardrails.description: Guardrail config + rolling-24h usage, or null when the readout is unavailable on this wallet.

has_seed.description: false on a view-only/wiped wallet. A boolean only — never the material.

lwk_version.description: The exact pinned lwk_node (LWK) version this build ships.

pending.description: Per-rail pending counters — the wallet_pending tally; use wallet_recover to re-drive them.

sync.description: Sync health (§2.5 meta): when the wallet last scanned/persisted and whether persistence is failing.

last_persist_error_name.description: Error NAME of the last failed persist (never a message/path), or null.

last_persist_failed_at.description: Epoch-ms of the last update-persist failure (§2.5), or null.

last_scan_at.description: Epoch-ms of the last completed scan pass, or null.

last_success_at.description: Epoch-ms of the last scan that also persisted, or null.

wallet_loaded.description: Whether the in-memory LWK state is initialized.

title: Wallet diagnostics
